limitations: No statistical model/task/LLM/service deployment implemented by this Source phase.
Only finite explicitly selected patients and recorded onset calendar range; no all-hospital population coverage, incidence, patient risk or outbreak diagnosis.
Definition and review are actual independent technical Super declarations, not professional qualification/validated surveillance criteria.
Raw naive clocks remain timezone unknown; capture UTC6 is separate and no historical as-of availability is claimed.
Same patient events are retained individually. No automatic dedup/episode independence claim.
NULL/empty/raw labels stay distinct; no normal/detected inference.
Private key remains SQL-only. Client without key cannot independently reconstruct HMAC projection; technical tokens do not guarantee anonymity.
No Snapshot delete/review API; immutable snapshots become inaccessible/stale through patient purpose, Definition, Review or whole-current changes.

Approval/rejection/withdrawal roots remain witness members; exact Review anchor uniqueness disallows later-winner replacement. Corrected reassessment needs a new explicit Definition version/root binding.

final_target_report.scope: 80 pure strict declaration/projection cases plus actual synthetic SQLite/current SQL/Main JWT ASGI/legacy writer targeted cases; no model/epidemiologic validation

final_mysql_report.scope: actual private MySQL ORM/source and two legacy functions; not HTTP/JWT/model execution

permanent_evidence.storage: Every archived item includes original byte length/SHA and lossless deterministic gzip/base64 of the actual original file. Decode base64→gzip then verify sha256 before interpreting. Original /tmp paths are provenance, not required storage.

unpersisted_tool_errors.resolution: corrected temporary generator import to alembic.operations.ops before any migration target passed; original tool output exists in session but no separate log file was captured. No fabricated replay evidence.
